attempts.summary: Configured /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app on node1 to rotate /var/log/inventory/app.log daily, keep 7 compressed rotations, and use copytruncate so the application can keep writing to the same file path after rotation. Verified rotation, compression, and continued writes via a forced rotation, then restarted node1 and confirmed the config, timer, and log data survived with a changed boot identity.
